description: This file defines a client-side React component for the 'Explore' page of a career navigator application. It manages UI state, fetches filter options from APIs, handles user search input, and renders search results, filters, and recommendations. It utilizes various hooks and components to enable an interactive job exploration interface.

methods.name: ExploreClient
methods.description: Main React functional component for the Explore page, managing state, effects, and rendering the UI.

methods.name: handleManualSearch
methods.description: Handles executing a search based on the current selected title and filters, updating search results state.
